basic_info.headline: AI-Assisted Software Development · IT & Network Operations
basic_info.meta_description: Trace Dugar’s portfolio: AI-assisted software development, Python application modernization, and IT and network operations.
basic_info.description: I combine IT and network operations experience with AI-assisted software development. My current work focuses on Python, application modernization, and secure, maintainable systems. Network support, field troubleshooting, and technical documentation shape how I approach engineering: understand the requirements, investigate failures, protect data, and verify the results. My background also includes audio engineering and full stack JavaScript training.

projects.title: Salmon Cookies
projects.description: Built a website for a fictional international cookie business using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. The project includes storefront information and a sales-management page.

projects.title: Odd Duck
projects.description: Built a product-voting application that presents three randomized options per round. Avoided duplicate and immediately repeated products to reduce selection bias, and displayed voting results in a chart.

projects.title: Role Based To-Do List
projects.description: Built a React task-management application using a third-party API. Implemented role-based permissions and settings for completed tasks and the number of tasks displayed.

projects.title: Virtual E-Store
projects.description: Built an e-commerce application using React, Redux Toolkit, Material UI, and Sass. Integrated third-party inventory data and product photography, with product details and a shopping cart.

projects.title: XLRX Logistics LLC Website Redesign
projects.description: Redesigned XLRX Logistics LLC’s website at the owner’s request using React, HTML, CSS, and Mantine UI. Implemented responsive layouts and a custom video background. The screenshots preserve the delivered version.

experience.title: IT Support Technician — NOC / Field
summary: Lead development of TanMar Safety Platform: modernize a legacy Xojo application and consolidate three applications into a bilingual training and compliance platform. Core workflows are implemented in the test environment; production hardening is underway.
Support office and field networks, NOC provisioning and diagnostics, and complex GPS and dashcam escalations. Create technical documentation and training materials.

experience.title: IT Support Technician

Consistently ranked among the top three help desk agents each month based on Freshworks performance metrics.
